hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
file=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')
if [[ "$file" =~ \.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json|css)$ ]] && [ -f "$file" ]; then
  dir=$(dirname "$file")
  while [ "$dir" != "/" ] && [ ! -x "$dir/node_modules/.bin/vp" ]; do dir=$(dirname "$dir"); done
  if [ -x "$dir/node_modules/.bin/vp" ]; then
    cd "$dir" && ./node_modules/.bin/vp fmt "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
fi

#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
file=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')
if [[ "$file" =~ \.(ts|tsx)$ ]] && [ -f "$file" ]; then
  dir=$(dirname "$file")
  while [ "$dir" != "/" ] && [ ! -x "$dir/node_modules/.bin/vp" ]; do dir=$(dirname "$dir"); done
  if [ -x "$dir/node_modules/.bin/vp" ]; then
    cd "$dir" && ./node_modules/.bin/vp check >&2 || echo "[Hook] vp check failed in $dir — run 'cd $dir && bun run check' for details" >&2
  fi
fi
exit 0

#!/bin/bash
# Relative import check — ~ alias required (client package only)
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')
if [ -n "$file_path" ] && [ -f "$file_path" ] && [[ "$file_path" =~ /packages/client/src/ ]]; then
  relative_imports=$(grep -nE "from ['\"]\.\.?/" "$file_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$relative_imports" ]; then
    echo "[Hook] WARNING: Relative import detected in $file_path" >&2
    echo "$relative_imports" | head -5 >&2
    echo "[Hook] Use '~/' alias instead of relative paths in @app/client src" >&2
  fi
fi

#!/bin/bash
# interface keyword check — use type instead
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')
if [ -n "$file_path" ] && [ -f "$file_path" ]; then
  interfaces=$(grep -nE "^[[:space:]]*(export )?interface " "$file_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$interfaces" ]; then
    echo "[Hook] WARNING: 'interface' found in $file_path — use 'type' instead" >&2
    echo "$interfaces" | head -5 >&2
  fi
fi

#!/bin/bash
# export default check — forbidden outside src/routes/, *.config.ts, Bun server entries, and Hono module entries
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')
if [ -n "$file_path" ] && [ -f "$file_path" ]; then
  if [[ ! "$file_path" =~ /routes/ ]] && [[ ! "$file_path" =~ \.config\.ts$ ]] && [[ ! "$file_path" =~ /packages/api/src/api\.ts$ ]] && [[ ! "$file_path" =~ /packages/client/server/server\.ts$ ]] && [[ ! "$file_path" =~ /packages/api/src/modules/[^/]+/[^/]+\.ts$ ]]; then
    defaults=$(grep -n "export default" "$file_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ -n "$defaults" ]; then
      echo "[Hook] WARNING: 'export default' found in $file_path" >&2
      echo "$defaults" | head -5 >&2
      echo "[Hook] Use named exports. Default exports are only allowed in src/routes/, *.config.ts, Bun server entries (packages/api/src/api.ts, packages/client/server/server.ts), and Hono module entries (packages/api/src/modules/<feature>/<feature>.ts)." >&2
    fi
  fi
fi

#!/bin/bash
# try-catch check — client code avoids try-catch; fate returns { error, result } and unexpected errors hit the error boundary
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')
if [ -n "$file_path" ] && [ -f "$file_path" ]; then
  if [[ "$file_path" =~ /packages/client/ ]] && [[ ! "$file_path" =~ \.(test|spec)\.(ts|tsx)$ ]]; then
    trycatch=$(grep -nE "(\} catch|try \{)" "$file_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ -n "$trycatch" ]; then
      echo "[Hook] WARNING: try-catch found in $file_path" >&2
      echo "$trycatch" | head -5 >&2
      echo "[Hook] Prefer fate's { error, result } pattern and let unexpected errors hit the error boundary." >&2
    fi
  fi
fi

#!/bin/bash
# no-index-files — block `index.ts` / `index.tsx` creation in source dirs (per .claude/rules/typescript/no-index-files.md)
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')
if [[ "$file_path" =~ /(packages|scripts)/.+/(src|server)/.*/index\.(ts|tsx)$ ]] || [[ "$file_path" =~ /(packages|scripts)/.+/(src|server)/index\.(ts|tsx)$ ]]; then
  echo "[Hook] WARNING: index file at $file_path" >&2
  echo "[Hook] Use a named file instead — e.g. modules/auth/auth.ts, server/server.ts, lib/db.ts." >&2
  echo "[Hook] See .claude/rules/typescript/no-index-files.md." >&2
fi
